svg.title: Clocking / Timebase block diagram — 4K cryogenic SoC
svg.desc: High-level block diagram of the Clocking/Timebase module showing reference clock input, Cryo PLL/DLL, multi-phase generation, clock distribution, drift calibration loop, jitter monitor, and CDC bridge between 4K and 300K domains. Clock paths shown in purple, control/config paths in amber dashed lines.

g.text: Drives: DMA · FE · DSL · Analog · Monitoring
